daily_note: Target is a completed JST date; this alone does not establish full-day coverage. A browser counts once per day for daily_visitors; a browser+article pair counts once per day for daily_article_reads. Neither is people, sessions or PV. Legacy snapshots without these fields are missing, not zero.
page_views_last_7_days_note: Article page_views_last_7_days covers seven JST calendar dates including measured_at_utc, through capture time; not seven completed days or the date_jst end-of-day total. Window/coverage is null when unavailable; missing/null article values are not zero.
page_views_report_day_note: recent_articles[].page_views_report_day is that article's PV on date_jst only, read from the same completed JST date as daily_page_views. Missing pre-activation history stays null/absent and is never reconstructed.
page_views_note: JavaScript-visible page displays, including repeat loads, with request retries deduplicated by view ID. Not people or completed article reads. Daily coverage is partial on the activation date unless tracking began at JST midnight. Pre-start dates are null/unmeasured. If the API lacks PV fields, available is false and counts/coverage are null. Cumulative site/article totals are measured at capture time, not the report date's midnight. Existing snapshots are never backfilled or overwritten.
note: visitors_cumulative and article readers are cumulative distinct browser identifiers, NOT people or PV. These browser counters are a point-in-time sample, not daily visitor totals.
continuation_note: continued_readers is cumulative unique browser IDs that arrived at a DIFFERENT article from this source article via a same-origin referrer path. One per browser and source; referrer-stripping undercounts. This is not an article-to-article click total or a conversion rate.
per_article_arrival_note: x_arrivals/search_arrivals are distinct anonymous browser identifiers per specific article and channel, counted only since that metric was enabled. A browser can be in both channels and several articles. They are NOT people, page views, clicks, daily visits or proof of X posts. Older snapshots without these fields must not be backfilled as zeros.
editorial_metadata_note: editorial_lane, editorial_tone and optional editorial_payoff are copied from article metadata at capture time. Pre-rollout stories remain null and are not backfilled. Payoff coverage begins later than lane/tone. Counts describe published articles, not traffic or quality scores.
channels_note: Cumulative browser IDs per observed incoming category since activation. Channels may overlap and are not people or page views. Source attribution is approximate; unattributed is not necessarily direct.
